inv.desc_en:
Une Estates offers you a ground floor premises at street level, commercial and suitable for any business, offices, financial insurance, consulting, dentists, doctors, and other shops, clothing stores, computer stores, current franchises.

The premises are currently used as offices, with 7 rooms, but can be left completely open plan.
Security street door and automatic shutter.
Led lights.
Fireproof textile flooring.
Air conditioning.
Electrical wiring, alarm.
1 bathroom.
The investment is very favourable and profitable due to the area of high value housing and residential, next to the polo club, and Club Esportiu Laietà, area of new projects of Barça, Camp Nou, university areas, all public transport L-5 L-3-L-9. Tram
Very good investment price for the present and future. €235,000, personalised visits with professional staff, to facilitate all enquiries.
